title: A-IEP Production Test Round
creator: A-IEP / Burnes Center
meta: Full end-to-end journey: sign-in, onboarding, upload, summary, translations, profile, referral invites, sign-out

items: It is a made-up IEP for a made-up child. Never upload a real student's IEP: this is the live production system and real IEPs are protected records.

items.t: Test on your phone browser first.

items: The app is built mobile-first. A desktop pass afterwards is a bonus, not the main event.

items.t: Signing in sends a real text message,

items: so use a phone you have with you.
After you press Upload, the wait is expected. Go make coffee, then come back. (i.e. 2-5 mins max)
including small things: typos, odd wording, cramped layout, a screen that felt slow.

header: A. You do NOT have an account
B. You already have an account
rows: Open the site, tap Log in, choose the phone option and enter your mobile number.
Enter the code you get by text. The account is created for you on first sign-in.
Open the site, tap Log in, and use the same number (or email and password) as before.
Enter the code you get by text.
The code arrives in about a minute, and onboarding starts (section 2).

rows.t: Note: You will get 2 OTP's when signing up for the first time

rows: The code arrives, and you land on your documents page with your previous document still there.
Change the language on the login screen before asking for the code. The text message and the screens should both follow that language.
Enter a wrong code once on purpose. You should get a clear error, not a blank screen or a crash.

items: Choose one that is not English (Spanish, Chinese or Vietnamese) so you can check the translation later.
The text should be in your chosen language, and nothing should be cut off.

items.t: Read and accept the consent form.

items: Before you accept, try to reach the IEP tool. It should hold you on the consent step.

items.t: You should land on the document upload page.

items: Upload Sample-IEP-for-Testing.pdf and note the time. Also try a file it should refuse, such as a photo (.png): you should get a readable message, not silence.
A processing state should appear. Leave the tab, come back, then refresh the page. The status should survive all three.
When it finishes you should see a summary for "Alex Example". Read it the way a parent would: is it plain language, does it match the PDF, does anything look made up?
Switch between English and your chosen language. The two should genuinely differ, and both should read naturally. Flag anything left untranslated.
Open every section: Strengths, Eligibility, Present Levels, Goals, Services, Accommodations, Placement, Key People, Consent. Each should open, hold real content, and point to page numbers.
Download the summary as a PDF and open it. Check that the language, the accent marks and any non-Latin characters survived.
Upload the same file again to replace the document. Processing should restart, finish, and leave no trace of the old summary.
Change your preferred language in the Account Center and reload. The change should stick, and the tool will ask you to re-upload if the translations don't exist for that language.

Visit FAQs, Parent Rights, Resources, About and Privacy Policy, both signed in and signed out. Watch for broken links, English leaking into a translated page, and text that is unreadable on a small screen.

items.t: Sign out, then sign back in.

items: Your document, language and profile should all still be there.
To test account deletion: Account Center, then Delete account. You can sign up again afterwards with the same number.

blocks.text: This one is brand new in production, so nobody outside the team has ever tried it.

items: Find it. Account Center, then Invite Other Parents. You should see "Your invite link" ending in /r/ and a short code, a Copy button, and share buttons for WhatsApp, text and email.
Open your own link. Copy it and open it in a private or incognito window. It should land on the A-IEP home page, not an error and not a login wall.
Join through it. In that private window, sign up as a brand new parent (pair with a teammate who has not signed up yet, or use a second number or email) and finish onboarding.
Check your numbers. Back on your Invite page, refresh. "Link visits" and "Parents joined" should both have gone up.
Check the privacy line. "Recent joins" should only say that a parent joined, with a date.
Try the share buttons. WhatsApp, text and email should each open with the link already filled in.

blocks.text: Screenshots help a lot. Attach them, or paste them under the table.
